Professional Summary
Data engineer with a proven track record designing and delivering scalable data pipelines and analytics platforms. Experienced in building ETL/ELT solutions, performance tuning SQL workloads, and operationalizing workflows for healthcare and financial domains. Strong emphasis on data quality, monitoring, and reproducible transformations.

Technical Skills
Python3, SQL, Apache Spark, Snowflake, dbt, CloudWatch, SQS, EC2, Apache Kafka, Databricks, Git, Jira, Linux

Work Experience

Senior Data Engineer, Orbit Health (May 2022 - Present)
- Architected and implemented Databricks-based ETL pipelines to ingest and transform patient claims and provider data, using Apache Spark and Python3 to process 3TB/month; optimized Spark jobs to reduce job runtime by 45% while maintaining data accuracy.
- Developed SQL-backed dimensional models in Snowflake and automated dbt-like transformation orchestration patterns using Python3 and Git; improved downstream report freshness from 24 hours to 4 hours.
- Built monitoring and alerting for data jobs using CloudWatch and SQS for job notifications and retries; reduced failed-job recovery time by 60% through automated restart logic.
- Collaborated with product and analytics teams via Jira, maintaining reproducible notebooks and Databricks repos to accelerate feature delivery.

Data Engineer, Medisure (Mar 2019 - Apr 2022)
- Replatformed batch ETL to Spark jobs running on managed clusters, converting legacy SQL transforms into dbt-style modular models and improving deployment repeatability via Git.
- Implemented change-data-capture and incremental load patterns with Apache Spark to load transactional claims data into Snowflake; cut compute costs by implementing efficient partitioning and pushdown filters.
- Created unit and integration tests for transformation logic and established deployment pipelines; coordinated release activities and tracked issues in Jira.
- Tuned SQL queries and Spark configurations to handle peak-month volumes, decreasing average job latency by 35%.

Data Engineer, Saffron Bank (Apr 2015 - Feb 2019)
- Designed real-time ingestion pipelines using Apache Kafka and Spark Streaming to capture transactions and events, delivering near-real-time feeds to downstream analytics and fraud detection systems.
- Implemented dbt-style transformation frameworks and scheduled ELT workflows on EC2-based infrastructure, managing orchestration, logging, and retries through CloudWatch and custom Python3 scripts.
- Built SQL-based reporting models in Snowflake and optimized Spark jobs for high-throughput financial datasets; improved end-to-end data delivery SLA from 6 hours to under 2 hours for critical feeds.
- Managed source control and collaboration using Git and tracked engineering work in Jira while ensuring Linux-based deployments remained stable.

Education
MBA (Marketing), IIM Indore
